details:
This update for snphost fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2026-41677: openssl: out-of-bounds read in PEM password callback when returning an oversized length
  (bsc#1270541).
- CVE-2026-41678: openssl: OOB write due to incorrect bounds assertion in `aes::unwrap_key()` (bsc#1270642).
- CVE-2026-41681: openssl: stack corruption due to `MdCtxRef::digest_final()` writing past caller buffer with no length
  check (bsc#1270720).
- CVE-2026-41898: openssl: information leak to network peers due to unchecked callback-returned length in PSK and
  cookie generate trampolines (bsc#1270799).
- CVE-2026-42327: openssl: undefined behavior in `X509Ref::ocsp_responders` when processing certificates with non-UTF-8
  OCSP URLs (bsc#1270527).
- CVE-2026-44662: openssl: heap buffer overflow when encrypting with AES key-wrap-with-padding (bsc#1270873).
- CVE-2026-45784: openssl: OOB write due to incorrectly sized output buffers in `CipherCtxRef::cipher_update_inplace`
  when it is used with AES key-wrap-with-padding ciphers (bsc#1270947).
